description: PLA category-level (category_l1 / category_l2 / category_l3) performance for a marketplace over ONE period: raw additive aggregates grouped by the category hierarchy - spend, impressions, clicks, PROGRAM (ad-attributed, per-click-timestamp) orders / revenue / product-views / add-to-carts, and SITE (whole-marketplace) product-views / add-to-carts / orders / revenue. Category values are normalized (NULL / empty / 'na' -> 'Unknown' at L1, '-' at L2/L3) so current and baseline pulls merge on the same keys. Spend is in the source table's stored currency (NOT currency-converted). Called once per period; run current + baseline separately for a comparison. cpc / cpm / ctr / roi and all comparison deltas are derived in the app layer from these raw aggregates.

category_l1.selector: CASE WHEN f.category_l1 IS NOT NULL AND f.category_l1 != '' AND LOWER(f.category_l1) != 'na' THEN f.category_l1 ELSE 'Unknown' END
category_l1.description: Top-level (L1) product category the spend/clicks/GMV were attributed to. NULL / empty / 'na' is normalized to 'Unknown'.

category_l2.selector: CASE WHEN f.category_l2 IS NOT NULL AND f.category_l2 != '' AND LOWER(f.category_l2) != 'na' THEN f.category_l2 ELSE '-' END
category_l2.description: Second-level (L2) product category. NULL / empty / 'na' is normalized to '-'.

category_l3.selector: CASE WHEN f.category_l3 IS NOT NULL AND f.category_l3 != '' AND LOWER(f.category_l3) != 'na' THEN f.category_l3 ELSE '-' END
category_l3.description: Third-level (L3) product category. NULL / empty / 'na' is normalized to '-'.

spend.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN f.pla_cost ELSE 0 END), 0)
spend.description: PLA ad spend for this category (source table stored currency; not currency-converted).

impressions.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN f.pla_impressions ELSE 0 END), 0)
impressions.description: PLA ad impressions for this category.

clicks.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN f.pla_clicks ELSE 0 END), 0)
clicks.description: PLA ad clicks for this category.

program_orders.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN f.program_per_click_timestamp_conversions ELSE 0 END), 0)
program_orders.description: PROGRAM (ad-attributed, per-click-timestamp) conversions / orders for this category.

program_revenue.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN f.program_per_click_timestamp_sales ELSE 0 END), 0)
program_revenue.description: PROGRAM (ad-attributed, per-click-timestamp) GMV / revenue / sales for this category. Used for roi = program_revenue / spend in the app layer.

program_viewproducts.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN f.program_per_click_timestamp_viewproduct ELSE 0 END), 0)
program_viewproducts.description: PROGRAM (ad-attributed, per-click-timestamp) product views for this category.

program_add_to_carts.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN f.program_per_click_timestamp_add_to_cart ELSE 0 END), 0)
program_add_to_carts.description: PROGRAM (ad-attributed, per-click-timestamp) add-to-carts for this category.

site_viewproducts.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN f.site_viewproducts ELSE 0 END), 0)
site_viewproducts.description: SITE (whole-marketplace, not ad-attributed) product views for this category.

site_add_to_carts.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN f.site_add2carts ELSE 0 END), 0)
site_add_to_carts.description: SITE (whole-marketplace, not ad-attributed) add-to-carts for this category.

site_orders.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN f.site_orders ELSE 0 END), 0)
site_orders.description: SITE (whole-marketplace, not ad-attributed) orders for this category.

site_revenue.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN f.site_revenue ELSE 0 END), 0)
site_revenue.description: SITE (whole-marketplace, not ad-attributed) revenue for this category (source table stored currency; not currency-converted).

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.marketplace_category_level_performance_facts_v2` AS f WHERE f.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND f.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__;
